changes.title: Crown whole
items: The oak's crown is whole over the Terrace: no gap or notch, a bigger canopy to land in
The Terrace is one of the house's rooms: hidden under the crown from outside, like every room
Both are switches on the pause page (Oak crown), to flip back

changes.title: Zoo real coasts
items: Zoo islands now have the same coastlines as on the sea chart, with their bays and points, once the chart has drawn them in your browser

changes.title: Hidden witch sliders
items: The pause page has a Hidden witch group: how strongly her silhouette shows through what hides her, how see-through things in front of her get, how soft that circle's edge is, and how tall something must be to fade
The Hidden witch group also sets her glow's colour (with a swatch) and strength, and her silhouette takes the colour
